translations.web: They will greet you, and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.
translations.bsb: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you will accept from their hands.
translations.kjv: And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.
